primitives.meaning: a deadline assigned to a specific obligation by a system or rule entitled to set one
entryFilters: a deadline assigned to a specific obligation by a system or rule entitled to set one
no instance of this journey is already open for the the obligation the deadline is attached to
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.does: Store the deadline with its timezone where that changes the answer, its source, the obligation it governs, its owner, and what would count as completion. The completion condition is the load-bearing part - a deadline that cannot say what would satisfy it can only ever measure elapsed time

cancelOn.meaning: the obligation is satisfied in the system of record
a defined point before the deadline is reached

primitives.reads: the the obligation the deadline is attached to re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.label: Completed
branches.test: the completion condition recorded with the deadline is satisfied

branches.label: Pre-deadline threshold
branches.test: a defined point before the deadline was reached with the obligation still open

primitives.does: Mark the obligation satisfied and invalidate every reminder and escalation still queued against it. A completed obligation is never reopened by a stale deadline job, which is the specific way a finished thing comes back to life

primitives.reEntry: a new obligation carries its own deadline; this one is closed

primitives.asks: Is a pre-deadline reminder useful here, and does policy define one?

branches.label: Send it
branches.test: policy defines a reminder at this threshold and the recipient can still act on it

branches.label: Nothing to send
branches.test: no reminder is defined, or nobody can do anything differently on hearing it

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it
a valid token or app session exists and the message is a single step from the notification
an asserted time bound lies inside the urgent horizon and permission for messages on this channel is recorded

primitives.purpose: Send the reminder defined for this threshold.
primitives.brief: Send the reminder defined for this threshold. The reminder schedule is not the deadline and does not move it - a deadline nobody was reminded about is still the deadline
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.asks: The deadline passed with the obligation open - what does the governing rule say happens?

branches.label: OVERDUE
branches.test: the obligation survives its deadline and changes operational state

branches.label: ESCALATED
branches.test: the rule raises it rather than changing the obligation itself

branches.label: EXPIRED
branches.test: the obligation itself ceases to be valid at the deadline

branches.label: FAILED
branches.test: the rule explicitly defines missing this deadline as failure

branches.label: STILL_VALID
branches.test: the deadline was a target and passing it changes nothing about the obligation

carries: the obligation and its original deadline history
the owner it was assigned to

primitives.on: a deadline whose governing rule escalates rather than changing the obligation
carries: the obligation, its deadline and how long it has been open

primitives.on: a deadline at which the obligation itself ceases to be valid
carries: the obligation and the validity period now ending

primitives.state: obligation failed at its deadline, as the rule defines
primitives.reEntry: a new attempt is a new obligation with its own deadline; this one records that it was not met
the obligation continues under whatever governs it - time passing did not decide anything here, which is the ordinary case and not an omission
